figs.name: pressure-tappings-in-orifice-plate-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to select corner, radius or flange pressure taps by pipe size and accuracy
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how pipe size and accuracy decide between corner, radius and flange taps, and why a change of tap type needs a new flow calculation.
figs.after_h2: How to Select the Right Pressure Tapping?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Orifice plate pressure tapping selection flowchart by pipe size and accuracy</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How to Select an Orifice Pressure Tapping</text>
<rect x="250" y="58" width="300" height="56" rx="10" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="91.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Know pipe size, standard, accuracy</text>
<line x1="400" y1="116" x2="400" y2="136" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,138.0 550.0,192 400,246.0 250.0,192" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="187.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Pipe below</text>
<text x="400" y="209.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2 inches?</text>
<line x1="552" y1="192" x2="590" y2="192" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="570" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="595" y="157" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="186.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Corner taps</text>
<text x="685.0" y="209.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at plate faces</text>
<line x1="400" y1="248" x2="400" y2="268" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="422" y="264" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<polygon points="400,272.0 550.0,330 400,388.0 250.0,330" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="325.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Above 6 inches and</text>
<text x="400" y="346.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">high accuracy?</text>
<line x1="552" y1="330" x2="590" y2="330" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="570" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="595" y="295" width="180" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="324.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Radius taps</text>
<text x="685.0" y="347.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1D and 0.5D</text>
<polyline points="248,330 140,330 140,380" fill="none" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="195" y="318" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="30" y="385" width="220" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="140.0" y="414.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flange taps</text>
<text x="140.0" y="437.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">1 inch each side</text>
<rect x="290" y="410" width="480" height="120" rx="10" fill="#fef3c7" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="530.0" y="441.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Before you finalise</text>
<text x="530.0" y="464.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ISO 5167: tap type must match the constants</text>
<text x="530.0" y="487.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Changing tap type changes the discharge</text>
<text x="530.0" y="510.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">coefficient, so recalculate the flow</text>
<line x1="252" y1="430" x2="288" y2="450" stroke="#b45309" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>

figs.name: pressure-tappings-in-orifice-plate-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: comparison of pressure tapping types with location and best use for each
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing flange, corner, radius, vena contracta, pipe and elbow taps by tap location and where each type is best used.
figs.after_h2: Comparison of Pressure Tappings in Orifice Plate
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Comparison of six orifice pressure tapping types infographic</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Comparison of Orifice Pressure Tappings</text>
<rect x="30" y="62" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="96" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="62" y="102" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1</text>
<text x="90" y="103" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Flange taps</text>
<text x="50" y="146" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">1 inch upstream and downstream</text>
<text x="50" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">most common, well standardised</text>
<rect x="410" y="62" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="96" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="442" y="102" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2</text>
<text x="470" y="103" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Corner taps</text>
<text x="430" y="146" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">at upstream and downstream faces</text>
<text x="430" y="180" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">best for small pipes below 2 in</text>
<rect x="30" y="224" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="258" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="62" y="264" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3</text>
<text x="90" y="265" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Radius taps</text>
<text x="50" y="308" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">1D upstream, 0.5D downstream</text>
<text x="50" y="342" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">6 inch and larger lines</text>
<rect x="410" y="224" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="258" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="442" y="264" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4</text>
<text x="470" y="265" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Vena contracta taps</text>
<text x="430" y="308" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">1D upstream, min pressure point</text>
<text x="430" y="342" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">maximum DP, less standardised</text>
<rect x="30" y="386" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#f0fdfa" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="62" cy="420" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="62" y="426" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5</text>
<text x="90" y="427" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Pipe taps</text>
<text x="50" y="470" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">2.5D upstream, 8D downstream</text>
<text x="50" y="504" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">older design, more variation</text>
<rect x="410" y="386" width="360" height="146" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0f766e" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="442" cy="420" r="17" fill="#0f766e"/>
<text x="442" y="426" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6</text>
<text x="470" y="427" font-size="20" fill="#134e4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Elbow taps</text>
<text x="430" y="470" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">outer and inner wall of an elbow</text>
<text x="430" y="504" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">low cost, lower accuracy</text>
</svg>
